correctness.rationale: A Roman dominating assignment is coordinatewise minimal iff every 1 has no adjacent 2 and each 2 has a private neighboring 0 for which it is the unique 2-neighbor. On H◦K1 the only possible core/leaf configurations are A=(2,0), B=(1,1), C=(0,1), D=(0,2); fix S of A cores, then C exactly on its external boundary ∂S and B or D independently on U=V\(S∪∂S). This establishes full weight enumerator M_H(z)=∑_S 2^|U| z^(2n-|∂S|). Marked cyclic gaps give H(t,z)=1+zt+z²t²/(1-2z²t); labeled cycles contribute n/k times gap coefficients, yielding the displayed cubic rational generating function and Pell–Lucas total. Maximizing ∂ size by ∑min(ell,2) gives floor(2n/3), hence min weight ceil(4n/3), and counting residue-class gap profiles gives min multiplicities 3, n(n+17)/6, or n according as n mod3 is 0,1,2. I independently brute checked all labelings of sunlets n=3,4 against subset boundary counts.
residual_risks: H finite simple and labeled; weight enumerator pointwise-minimal Roman functions only, not polynomial-time graph algorithm.
Sunlet formulas only simple C_n n>=3, formal low-order coefficients are not graph claims.
